title: Record page: an empty field in the synthesized 「更多详情」 group is not revealed or counted by 「显示空字段」
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the f7-record area thread while measuring #36292 live (app-crm, zh-CN, a `crm_lead` record); observed once, not dug into. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

On an app-crm lead, the empty 备注 (a textarea field) sits in a synthesized 「更多详情」 group on the record page. In read mode that group is not drawn, even after the user presses 「显示 2 个空字段」, and the count in that button leaves the field out. The field appears only in edit mode. So a reader cannot see that the field exists, and the empty-field count is wrong by one.

## To do

1. Reproduce on main: an object whose layout leaves a textarea to the synthesized 「更多详情」 group, with the field empty.
2. Find where the synthesized group drops out of read mode and of the empty-field count (the record detail view's section synthesis and the empty-field reveal).
3. Make the synthesized group follow the same reveal rule as authored sections, and count its empty fields.

## Acceptance

- With the field empty, 「显示 N 个空字段」 counts it, and pressing it draws the field in read mode, in the 「更多详情」 group.
- A pin covers the synthesized group's reveal and count.

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui. Every user reading a record whose layout leaves a field to the synthesized group sees a wrong count and cannot reveal it; there is a workaround (edit mode).
